turn-on-dark-mode-with-shortcut.title: Dark Mode Keyboard Shortcut for Mac
turn-on-dark-mode-with-shortcut.intro: Set up a keyboard shortcut to turn on Dark Mode on your Mac without opening System Settings. Import this Rulr rule and choose the key combination you want to use.

organize-new-downloads.title: Automatically Organize Downloads on Mac
organize-new-downloads.intro: Keep your Mac Downloads folder organized by automatically moving new files to a folder you choose. Select a destination different from Downloads before enabling the rule.

organize-downloaded-images.title: Automatically Sort Downloaded Images on Mac
organize-downloaded-images.intro: Sort new image downloads into a separate folder on your Mac. This Rulr rule watches Downloads and moves files with matching extensions such as PNG, JPEG, and HEIC.

organize-downloaded-pdfs.title: Automatically Sort Downloaded PDFs on Mac
organize-downloaded-pdfs.intro: Organize PDFs as they arrive in your Mac Downloads folder. This Rulr rule checks each new filename for the .pdf extension and moves matching files to your chosen folder.

rename-new-files.title: Automatically Rename New Files on Mac
rename-new-files.intro: Rename files automatically as they arrive in a Mac folder you choose. Set the replacement name in Rulr and use numbered filenames to handle name conflicts.

window-switcher.title: Mac Window Switcher with a Keyboard Shortcut
window-switcher.intro: Switch between open windows on your Mac with a visual picker. Press Option + Tab to open the picker, then select the window you want to bring forward.

insert-plain-text.title: Paste Without Formatting on Mac
insert-plain-text.intro: Paste as plain text on Mac with Option + V. This Rulr rule strips formatting from clipboard text before inserting it into the active app.

copy-screen-text.title: Copy Text from Images on Mac with OCR
copy-screen-text.intro: Extract text from images, screenshots, or apps visible on your Mac screen. Press your Rulr shortcut to run OCR on the screen and copy the recognized text to the clipboard.

switch-audio-output.title: Switch Audio Output on Mac with a Keyboard Shortcut
switch-audio-output.intro: Use a keyboard shortcut to switch your Mac audio output to a chosen speaker, pair of headphones, or display without opening Sound settings.
